label: Scenario 1
title: Scenario 1: the harness reads the label and picks the zone and arm, WALLX picks the bag up and puts it into that zone

steps.title: Read the label, choose zone + arm, build the WALLX prompt
steps.detail: Barcode reader first, pincode OCR reader as fallback. Pincode 940/941/950/951 → zone 1 → left arm; 900-902 → zone 2 → right arm; else zone 3. The zone number and arm are written into the WALLX sentence.
steps.prompt: Read the label with the barcode reader (pincode OCR reader as fallback), choose the zone and the arm.

steps.title: WALLX picks the bag up and puts it into the zone
steps.detail: WALLX (wall-x 2610-dualhead-v2, organisers' server) starts from rest. Every call it gets the HEAD camera image (black wrist images) + both arms' state + the sentence above and returns an action chunk for both arms. The harness LOCKS the arm the zone does not use, runs 40% of each chunk per call (--slow 0.4) and keeps the same sub-goal (--no-reset-on-subgoal). 60 calls. WALLX alone does the grasp, the lift, the carry and the set-down.

steps.title: Release
steps.detail: The acting claw opens fully where WALLX left it, then lifts 8 cm straight up.
steps.prompt: Open the claw fully and lift straight up.

steps.title: Both arms home
steps.detail: Both arms go to rest (≤ 5 cm per call).
steps.prompt: Both arms: go to rest.

steps.title: Done
steps.detail: Session ends; video, every call (state, actions, images) and the log are saved.

steps.title: Read the label, route to zone 1
steps.detail: Barcode reader first, pincode OCR reader as fallback. Code 420/95126/001 = pincode 951 → zone 1 → left arm.

steps.prompt: Read the label with the barcode reader (pincode OCR reader as fallback), choose the zone and the arm.

steps.title: Pick + handover
steps.detail: the right arm picks the box and hands it to the left claw in the air.

sub.text: right arm moves from home to above the box (claw closed)
right claw opens and lowers around the box
right claw closes on the box (grasp)
right arm lifts the box to the handover point (~18 cm up, table centre)
left claw opens and reaches in
left claw closes on the box: both claws hold it
right claw opens: the box is in the left claw only

steps.prompt: Right arm: pick up the purple box and hand it to the left arm in the air.

steps.title: Right arm backs off
steps.detail: Move (≤ 4 cm per call): right claw lifts and moves away to (0.35, 0.20, 0.26) m so it cannot hit the box or the left arm.
steps.prompt: Right arm: let go and move up and away from the box.

steps.title: Right arm home
steps.detail: Home, claw closed. From here the right arm stays parked.
steps.prompt: Right arm: go to rest.

steps.title: WALLX places the box into zone 1 (left arm)

WALLX alone decides where to move, how to lower and where to set the box down.

steps.title: Release
steps.detail: The left claw opens fully where WALLX left it, then lifts 8 cm straight up, so the box stays inside zone 1.
steps.prompt: Open the claw fully and lift straight up.

label: Scenario 5
title: Scenario 5: WALLX picks up the hat and puts it into the right corner bin; when a person moves it, the harness sees it and restarts WALLX on the new spot

steps.title: Read the label, choose zone + arm
steps.prompt: Read the label with the barcode reader (pincode OCR reader as fallback), choose the zone and the arm.
steps.detail: Cap label 90291 → zone 2 → right arm.

steps.title: Locate the cap on the 3x3 table grid
steps.prompt: Find the cap on the head camera and name its grid cell.
steps.detail: Tracks the cap on the head camera and maps it to the table grid (back / middle / front x left / middle / right); the cell goes into the WALLX sentence.

steps.title: WALLX picks up the hat and puts it into the right corner bin
steps.detail: WALLX does all the motion (head camera + both gripper cameras, left arm locked, 230 calls at 30% speed, one prompt). The harness keeps watching the cap on its grid every call: when the cap sits in a NEW cell for 3 calls, the prompt is cancelled, WALLX's history is reset and WALLX starts the task again from the hat's new spot. When WALLX starts to close the claw, the harness first takes the open claw down to grab height (no depth camera on this robot). Red marks on the timeline = re-targets.

steps.title: Release
steps.prompt: Open the claw fully and lift straight up.
steps.detail: The right claw opens fully where WALLX left it, then lifts 8 cm.

steps.title: Right arm home
steps.prompt: Right arm: go to rest.
steps.detail: The right arm goes to rest; the left arm never moved.

steps.title: Done
steps.detail: Session ends; video, every call (state, actions, images) and the log are saved.

label: Phone scan
title: Handheld scanner: the left hand holds the phone, the right hand holds the parcel; the phone scans the label, the harness routes it, WALLX sorts the parcel

steps.title: Both hands open at the scan pose
steps.prompt: Both arms: open the claws in front of the robot, facing each other.
steps.detail: The two claws face each other about 20 cm apart, 18 cm above the table.

steps.title: Load the phone (left) and the parcel (right)
steps.prompt: Put the phone in the LEFT claw (camera toward the right claw) and the parcel in the RIGHT claw (label toward the phone).
steps.detail: 25 s to place both.

steps.title: Gentle grip on the phone and the parcel
steps.prompt: Close slowly until the fingers touch; hold the phone without squeezing.
steps.detail: Each claw closes in small steps and stops as soon as its fingers meet the object (the measured opening stops following); the phone is held just 0.02 past contact, the parcel a little firmer. That hold is kept for the rest of the run.

steps.title: The phone scans the label; the harness routes the code
steps.prompt: Read the label with the handheld scanner, choose the zone.
steps.detail: The phone (3x) sends frames to the dashboard, which decodes the barcode / QR / pincode; the harness routes it (940/941/950/951 → zone 1, 900-902 → zone 2, else zone 3) and writes the zone into the WALLX sentence. The arms hold still until a scan arrives.

steps.title: Left hand takes the phone out of the way
steps.prompt: Left arm: back toward rest, keep holding the phone.
steps.detail: The phone stays gripped.

steps.title: WALLX carries the parcel into the scanned zone (right arm)
steps.detail: WALLX (wall-x 2610-dualhead-v2) gets the head camera + both arms' state + the sentence above every call. The left arm (holding the phone) is locked and keeps its gentle grip. 60 calls.

steps.title: Release the parcel
steps.prompt: Open the right claw and lift straight up.
steps.detail: The parcel drops into the zone.

steps.title: Right arm home
steps.prompt: Right arm: go to rest.

steps.title: Left hand brings the phone back
steps.prompt: Left arm: bring the phone back to the front.

steps.title: Take the phone
steps.prompt: Take the phone out of the LEFT claw now (hold it: the claw opens next).

steps.title: Left claw opens
steps.prompt: Open the left claw slowly.
steps.detail: Opens to 1.2 (not the full width).

steps.title: Left arm home
steps.prompt: Left arm: go to rest.

steps.title: Done
steps.detail: Session ends; video, every call and the log are saved.
